agency.name: Mitteldeutscher Verkehrsverbund (MDV)
agency.operating_note: Saxony's first reviewed feed record. The MDV association network around Leipzig and Halle, published as stop-level GTFS.

findings.effort: A small file for most flat-fare systems.
findings.fix: Add fare_attributes.txt (or Fares v2 files) with your fare structure. If your service is fare-free, ask to have it marked fare-free instead.
findings.what: The feed contains no fare information.
findings.why: Riders see 'fare unknown' in trip planners and can't budget their trip; visitors are most affected.

findings.what: feed_info.txt has no technical contact (feed_contact_email or feed_contact_url).
findings.why: App makers and state data programs have nobody to email when they spot a problem. Small errors then sit in the feed for months.

findings.fix: Set agency_url to your agency's website, starting with https://.
findings.what: agency.txt has no working website URL.
findings.why: Trip planners link riders to this URL for schedules and fares.

completeness.name: completeness
completeness.summary: This feed has no stops to state wheelchair accessibility for. Fare data is not published.

findings.fix: Review the rule documentation for 'missing_required_file' at https://gtfs-validator.mobilitydata.org/rules.html and check the flagged rows in your feed.
findings.what: Missing required file (flagged by the MobilityData validator).
findings.why: See the linked rule for what this affects.

findings.fix: Review the rule documentation for 'missing_calendar_and_calendar_date_files' at https://gtfs-validator.mobilitydata.org/rules.html and check the flagged rows in your feed.
findings.what: Missing calendar and calendar date files (flagged by the MobilityData validator).
findings.why: See the linked rule for what this affects.

findings.effort: One small file, set once in export settings.
findings.fix: Add feed_info.txt with publisher name, URL, language, and feed_start_date/feed_end_date.
findings.what: A file GTFS asks for (usually feed_info.txt) is missing.
findings.why: feed_info.txt tells apps who publishes the feed and when it expires; without it nobody is warned before data goes stale.

findings.effort: A quick look at the flagged file.
findings.fix: Check the flagged file name for a typo of a standard GTFS file. Remove it if it is a vendor extra.
findings.what: The feed includes a file that is not part of the GTFS spec.
findings.why: Apps ignore files they don't know, and a stray file can hide a misspelled standard file name.

correctness.name: correctness
correctness.summary: The MobilityData validator flagged 4 kinds of issue across 9 instances (6 error, 1 warning, 2 informational).

findings.fix: Add feed_start_date and feed_end_date to feed_info.txt and include calendar end dates in your export.
findings.what: Neither feed_info.txt nor the calendars state when service ends.
findings.why: Nobody can tell when this feed will go stale.

freshness.name: freshness
freshness.summary: No service end date could be found in this feed, so there is no way to know when riders will lose trip planning.
